remarks: Welcome to this meticulously maintained, original-owner ranch in the desirable Town of Tonawanda! Owned and cared for by the same owner since it was built, this 3-bedroom home reflects years of pride of ownership and thoughtful upkeep. It offers a comfortable and convenient single-story layout with plenty of additional space in the partially finished basement. Recently repainted and featuring hardwood floors throughout, this is a home that has been well cared for from day one. Inside you will find a large eat-in kitchen and a beautifully renovated bathroom featuring a heated floor, walk-in shower with sliding glass door, tiled surround, and built-in niche. One of the three bedrooms provides direct access to the rear porch overlooking the backyard. The partially finished basement offers additional living, recreation, or hobby space along with plenty of storage and a generator hookup. Additional features include a hot water tank replaced in 2021, a garage with separate electric service, and a large concrete driveway offering plenty of off-street parking. Enjoy a convenient location within walking distance of Kenny Field and the Tonawanda Rails to Trails bike path, along with quick access to the I-290 and plenty of restaurants, shopping, and everyday conveniences. With only one owner, meticulous maintenance, a desirable ranch layout, and thoughtful updates throughout, this is the type of home where pride of ownership is evident from the moment you arrive. Open House Saturday 10/3 from 11am-1pm
